shared_elements: shallow relief carving on weathered grey stone
horizontal band / register line running across the surface
curvilinear incised outlines enclosing rounded forms
paired symmetrical elements flanking a central axis (loosely)
justification: Both are worn stone surfaces worked in shallow relief and both carry a horizontal banded division below a zone of rounded, outlined forms, which is the most specific correspondence I can honestly claim. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a vertical, frontal, near-symmetrical block covered with abstract geometric motifs (discs, loops, rope-like bands), while B is a horizontal narrative-style register with a modelled, profile winged creature rendered with feather-like texturing and far greater naturalism.
